summary: P01 V2.47.241 replaces the prior Course Study Workspace with a direct internal Markdown Course Reader. Course cards and Continue Learning open the reader directly; a single course ZIP is stored as resource_asset_files.course_package against the existing canonical books asset. ZIP folders become chapter groups, Markdown files become lessons, numeric prefixes control order, the first real H1 supplies the title, common GitHub repository wrappers are ignored, and relative images/Markdown links are resolved inside the package. The reader provides article content, generated catalog, previous/next navigation, browser-local notes/resume/completion state, and Owner course-package replacement. The package path is fail-closed for MIME/ZIP/path/symlink/file-count/expanded-size/per-file/extension checks; raw HTML and executable content are not executed, and file serving remains bound to the existing course/resource authority. Disaster Recovery includes the course package through the existing resource-asset recovery pipeline. No new table, canonical domain, schema version, migration, auth/session/permission/secret/access-control, updater mechanism, provider/server, or automatic Production write is introduced. Exact-source canonical/focused Security/DR proof and Clean FULL/Atomic UPDATE/data preservation/idempotency/rollback gates are PASS. OWNER explicitly rejected temporary Preview/manual candidate testing; Production remains Owner-manual.
